toxicGrowth: Deal X damage and give +X attack permanently to a friendly Entity.
sacrifice: Select a friendly Entity, it dies. Set X to its mana cost.
ravage: Select a friendly Entity to deal its attack as damage to a random opposing Place or HQ.
miraculousHealing: Heal a friendly Entity and increase the attack of this Entity by the amount healed.
harden: Deal X damage and give +X health permanently to a friendly Entity.
grow: Grow your HQ, 4 Growth increases your HQ's mana production each turn by 1 permanently.
cleanse: N random cards from the opposing Dustpile are moved into the Void.
bloodlust: Deal X damage to a friendly Entity and X damage to a random opposing Entity.
ascension: Move a friendly Entity from the Dustpile into the Void and create an X/X Avatar with X being the voided card's mana cost.
ambush: A friendly Entity deals its attack damage to an opposing Entity.
fight: A friendly Entity and the selected opposing Entities deal their attack damage to each other simultaneously.
onDiscard: Whenever you discard a card, activate Effects.
requiem: If at least N Entities in your Dustpile share a tag with this card, activate Effects.
criticality: At the beginning of your turn, if X is at least N, activate Effects.
onDestruction: Whenever another friendly Place is destroyed, activate Effects.
rally: Set X to the number of friendly Entities on the Field that share a tag with this card.
reprogram: Replace a random effect on an Action card in your hand with a specified Effect.
corpseExplosion: Move a friendly Entity from your Dustpile into the Void and deal X damage to the selected opposing Entities.
autopsy: Move a friendly Entity from your Dustpile into the Void and set X to its health.
salvage: Deal X damage to a friendly Place and produce X mana.
